suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: Renders the demo shop and the web profiler panel
suggest.symfony/web-profiler-bundle: Shows the BatteryIncluded api calls in the toolbar and profiler
suggest.ext-intl: Localized prices, numbers and dates in the demo shop
suggest.symfony/http-client: Sends the api calls with a (scoped) Symfony http client, see batteryincluded.http_client
suggest.symfony/messenger: Syncs and deletes documents asynchronously with SyncDocumentsMessage and DeleteDocumentsMessage
suggest.symfony/lock: Prevents parallel runs of bi:export with the lock of the application
suggest.symfony/cache: Caches rarely changing api responses, see batteryincluded.cache
suggest.symfony/monolog-bundle: Logs failed and slow api calls to the batteryincluded channel
